reviews.review_description: Very prompt to arrange a time to thoroughly talk through the work we wanted and to send a quote with options. Installers rocked up on time, very pleasant and easy to deal with, and did a very neat install and left the site tidy. Also quickly and easily helped with connecting the EV charger to the enphase app.

I’ve deliberately waited 18 months after installation to see whether there have been any after installation service issues. There haven’t been , the system continues to work seamlessly.Green Edge weren’t the cheapest of the 3 quotes provided by Solar Quotes, but they were the only one prepared to send a representative out to my property to view the roof and take me through my options. Lucas was excellent to deal with, knowledgeable and thorough. That additional service on the investment we were making in the panels represented real value for money from my perspective.Unsurprisingly given this professionalism, the installation process went totally smoothly.

Quoting was straight forward. Provided lots of information about our options and spent time discussing how the options aligned to our goal (pros, cons, future considerations, etc.). He wanted us to be able to make the right choice for our needs, and didn't pressure us to pick them (no gimmicks, no pushy sales calls). We felt he cared more that we were able to make a smart decision, even if that was to choose another provided. We felt he had nothing to hide and wasn't thinking profit over all else (didn't push to upsell to a size/product that didn't benefit our goal).Installation took 2 days for our system and the team were professional but down to earth and fun to chat with. They clearly loved what they do and were happy to explain anything to us that we asked about. They also listened to us when we had input and if something we preferred wasn't possible (would fail inspection), they explained why and helped find the most appropriate middle ground between what made us happy and what would meet requirements. They also handled obstacles (like our hard to access roof and the difficult angle inside the wall) with patience and expertise.Customer service was excellent at every step so far, and we don't feel anything has been kept from us (every change to the original plan was discussed when an issue first appeared so we understood what/why/how and could be involved where appropriate). They have taken care of most admin items (rebates/loans required us to do our parts), which has made this a very low stress experience.Currently awaiting inspection and then grid approval, both of which they handle administratively.Would 100% use them again, and highly recommend them to everyone!

We had 3 quotes done, and each company was well presented and easy to understand.   The initial quote was high and a system too big, so we asked them to review it down and similar to the other 2.  Once all 3 were then done we went for the company that we felt most comfortable with in both the representative and the company research we did.   The installation was only a few weeks later and done in 2 days.   The installers were very helpful and knowledgeable answering any questions I had.   The only issue was having the system inspected and it took more than 10 days for this to happen.   The company was helpful with this and answered my emails within hours.

I selected Greenedge technologies based in their people and service. They were the most expensive of the 3 quotes I recurved but only but by about 12%.They were the only ones to actually visit my home to give a quote and this made a definitive difference to the design and effective operation of the system.Communication was quick, effective and they always met all their dates and commitments.Installation team were very professional  and the job was done well with good communication from the team as it progressed. They continually made an effort to ensure the quality of their work and made sure any damaged roof tiles were replaced and let me know exactly what they were doing.I'd definitely recommend Green Edge for quality, professionalism and peace of mind for a new solar user like me.

Of the three companies we contacted GreenEdge was the only one that immediately set up an onsite visit. The other two companies just sent a quote based on satellite photos. Salesman (Joshua) was friendly, patient and informative including with us making quite a few follow up calls with more questions. Because he had visited onsite he picked up a couple of issues which the other companies did not. Joshua also sorted out a heat pump hot water service for us, which we were already planning on getting.  The installation team was friendly and efficient and seemed OK with me hanging around and asking about the process. Communications with the office staff was very friendly and efficient. Every step along the way was clearly explained. Comms with our power company was included. Even though we paid a bit more than the other quotes for a comparable system, we felt it was well worth it. No hesitations recommending GreenEdge.

They installed both solar panels and a heat water pump. Very happy from beginning to end. Excellent communication, prompt and tidy tradesman and made the whole process (including dealing with the Victorian Gov't paperwork) as easy as possible. I know nothing about this technology and was quite daunted by the idea of commmissioning this work but they made it as painless as possible.  A small problem did occur due to the roof scaffolding but I don't believe it was their fault and have always been of the opinion that sometimes unexpected problems will occur. What interests me the most, is how a company deals with those problems. This one, inmediately sent someone out and it was sorted that monring. Very happy and would definitiely recommend them. Thank you for a great job.

Wonderful experience from the sales process through to the installation.  We are very happy with the system, excellent workmanship, and very professional people. Would definitely recommend them to anybody.

Prompt and professional sales person Lucas who responded promptly to my needs and concerns. Advised new recommendation on panel types prior to install and the team kept me informed through process with the government solar rebates and getting the set up via electricity distributor and retailer. Allowed me the time to think through what I really wanted.  Technical staff performed onsite visit to inform best system to install on a older single fronted joined house on both sides. Allowed me the time to think through what I really wanted.  Rec panels and enphase  micro inverters and monitoring system installed. Installation process all completed with minimal fuss in a day. It did take the independent electrical inspector almost 4 weeks to come to certify the install. Now  post 3 months post all working as expectedRecommend the team at Green Edge.

Extended quotation process as it involved removing an old system, but they were prompt and helpful in their answers.Installation was neatly done, with a polite, self sufficient crew, so I kept working from home the entire time.  Explained to me what they planned to do, and provided advice and opinions on future options I might take.  Has run smoothly since being commissioned.

I found the sales person very knowledgeable and helpful. Thanks, Lucas. The installation process went as I'd been advised, without any hiccups. The staff did a good job as far as I can tell. The electrician could have been a bit more responsive to my many questions - he always seemed to be in a hurry - but overall the installers were polite, professional and helpful. The back office staff handled my email inquiries promptly and professionally. Overall, I highly recommend Green Edge Technologies.
Green Edge were very helpful and tidy. Excellent panels and inverter. I am waiting for the price to come down before I get a battery.
Great customer service from all involved, from start to finish they showed real professionalism in the all their fields of expertise.

The sales/quoting process was handled very well.THe installation sheculing was not easy but a large part of this was the frequent bad weather in Melbourne playing havock with schedules.The actual instalation was handeled very well by a polite and knowledgeable crew.  It took longer than indicate in the quote but that was becasue the quote time was unrealistic (error in the quote).Customer servicde was very good.

From the start of the quoting process through to installation, the Green Edge team were excellent. Harry took the time to conduct a site visit and talk us through options, then gave multiple adjustments to the quotes and answered questions as we made our decisions. The quotes were competitive with other suppliers. Cathal and the installation team were very professional and communicated clearly what was happening and the timelines. We were very happy with the overall service provided.

Thanks for attending onsite. Installation was great and when the weather turn against the completion the communication and subsequent reschedule was really good. Post installation communication was clear and concise.
Lucas from Greenedge took the time to visit our place and consult and explain everything well
Prompt attendance, 1 day installation, fast turnaround of paperwork, inspections complete, system exceptional and performing above expectation.Easy communication
Salesperson very friendly, informative and appeared to have our best interests in mindInstallation was efficient, despite rainy weatherExcellent communication throughout
The sales person came out to see me and explained the process, installation gone smoothly

They made everything so clear and easy. I didn't have to guess or wonder about anything.The installers were well organised and very polite and accommodating.Once I decided to go ahead, I had solar installed just a couple of weeks later.
5 star service. Josh was awesome to deal with and work was to a high standard.

Harry was an excellent sales rep. He was extremely accommodating with my requests for many variations of quotes (size, brands, etc.) Until we came up with what I believe was the best combination for my circumstances. The installation   Team were excellent. Punctual, hard working, friendly and very tidy. They also were able to check over my roof for broken tiles (not in installation area) and replaced several broken ones while they were up there. All in all an excellent service from start to finish that I would highly recommend.

The Sales Quoting Process:Green Edge Technologies, were the quickest to call me for a quote and were certainly the most thorough when it came to designing a system that would be the best for us. Other suppliers just wanted to sell us a "standard" system and didn't want to understand our usage or requirements. I asked sales person many many questions and ultimately asked for a number of quotes for different systems. He was very patient and attentive - nothing seemed too much to ask.(This is probably the single most thing that got us over the line)The Installation:The installers were on time, professional and very polite. I'm very happy with the quality of the install they did and in particular the inverter in the garage is very neatly installed. The guys swept can cleaned up their work area in the garage after completion.Post Install:The independent inspector came out onsite a few days latter and checked the system. He quickly gave to OK to start using the system.We're currently waiting for the Power Company to swap over the meter so that we can start to feed back into the grid.These steps were outlined in a follow up email and document from Green Edge Technologies.In summary, this is a company I would be happy to recommend to my elderly mother.

Harry was our first point of contact with the company. He took the time to work out what we wanted, answered all our curly questions and gave us several quotes for different panel brands, having explained the differences to us.For the installation, Benn and his team were fantastic. Ours was a two day job (25 Hyundai panels) and they turned up on time each day, got about their work efficiently and were very respectful of our property. One of the panels was faulty and they picked this up before installing it, coming back a few days later to install a replacement. I was really impressed that they went to some trouble concealing all the cabling inside the walls rather than using exposed conduits. We also had a car charger installed and will be getting a Tesla Powerwall 2 installed when they are available. All of Benn's team were cheery, polite and they cleaned up after themselves.Benn set up the Enphase software and helped us to get going with the monitoring app. He was very happy to answer all our questions and has made himself available for us to phone him with any questions. We will definitely go with Green Edge Technologies again in future.

All three companies asked to quote attended our property. They were all polite, friendly and willing to spend the time to explain the pros and cons of the batteries they were recommending. Two quotes were within range of each other (although not the cheapest), and were able to install the battery in the garage, whereas the third one would have required us to provide extra infrastructure (concrete slab and weather protection canopy) so the battery could be installed near the switchboard. It was just about impossible to pick between these two, but in the end my husband decided on Green Edge because he and the sales rep had previously had very similar careers. We also decided to install an extra 10 panels, so now have a 10 kw system.I received a high level of support in applying for the Victorian Government battery rebate, which was successful. The installation took place about 4 weeks after receiving the quotes, and was completed in one day. All team members were polite, arrived on time and cleaned up after themselves.Ben ensured I was able to get the app and understand it. He returned 3 days later to make some minor program adjustments. Final inspection and connection will be delayed until January because of the Christmas break. Most comforting, is the fact I have his direct mobile number should I need to contact him in the future. This is way, way better service than I have experienced with two previous installations at previous homes. This is the third installation of panels and the first of a battery over the last seven years.

I enjoyed dealing with GET from start to finish. Josh in sales asked lots of questions to understand our needs and budget. Answered any questions we had. Office staff were really helpful and quick to respond. The install team led by owner Ben were really nice guys who were professional and just got it done. Ben found a solution to an unforeseen issue and was upfront about it and communicated well.  They worked hard in high temps and I couldn’t fault them. Walked us through things post install . Great after sales call from Josh.  Wouldn’t hesitate to use them again. *****

Quoting process was simple, team contacted me and was happy to talk about systems and compare benefits.Installation took only a few hours, team cleaned up after themselves.  Only one small issue with minor damage to the roof, which the team organised an immediate repair for.Still waiting for rebates from electricity provider, but that’s expected.

The process from the quoting phase to installation was quick, smooth and professional.Josh was great at answering all of my questions, providing outstanding service.We are so excited to be making a positive  difference to the environment and we look forward to saving lots of $.

Green Edge Technologies responded very quickly to our enquiry, were highly knowledgeable which gave us confidence, understood exactly what we needed, and promptly provided a reasonable quote incorporating quality components (Trina, Fronius, Sonnen) with long-term warranty.The installation team arrived on time as scheduled, completed their work neatly within the timeframe specified, and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards.Customer service was equally professional. Everything needed to finalise installation - paperwork, inspections, information on rebates etc - was organised and smooth.We would most certainly recommend Green Edge Technologies.

Before we were like 'Ohm my god!'Wired. Really amped up; shocking how it Hertz to recall. We thought were powerless - E14 screwed with no outlet.The guys were so bright though - the whole 5 x gang switched on. Practically incandescent and on point with current tech.Now? I love lamp.(I realise that's a quote and not a pun - I'm stopping now anyway)Do recommend Josh / Greenedge Technologies.(Good, neat work. Didn't even break any roof tiles - should've lead with that)- D. James

We dealt with Vincent, who came to our place to have a discussion and quote with us regarding our solar panel requirements. Vincent was friendly, and was also honest with his opinions on what would work for us and what wouldn't. We also asked for a few alterations to our design due to us not being sure on what would work with us. Vincent did not hesitate to send through the alterations, as well as his advice on what would and wouldn't work.After picking a design that we were happy with, we then had a visit from Benn to physically check out the area where the panels were going. A date was then set for installation. On the day of installation, the installers turned up promptly. The installation went ahead with no fuss, and the installation site was left spotless.We were told that all the necessary paperwork and coordination with the inspector and energy retailer would be done.And sure enough, within days of the installation being completed, we got a phone call from the inspector to arrange a time for inspection. That came and went without a hitch as well.All in all, from the time that we got our first phone call from Green Edge Technologies to the time the inspector flicked the inverter on after inspection, it took less than 2 months. We found the experience of dealing with Green Edge Technologies to be so pleasant, that we have already recommended them to other friends who are in the market for a solar installation at their place.

The interactions with Green Edge Technologies were positive - at every stage.The sales and quoting included a site visit and the design was adjusted a few times to account for revisions we needed to make. I was always clear about where we were going.The installation was quick. In our case, because we had a slightly larger system (10kW), this occurred over two days. There were a few commissioning problems with the Solar Analytics monitor that we had installed at the same time. the team took responsibility for solving the problems - at no stage was I concerned.

We were looking to expand our current system and to install a battery. Joel was very informative and not pushy, the whole process and scope of work was explained in detail. The guys carrying out the installation were professional, friendly, polite and courteous. The whole operation was carried out with a minimum of fuss.
Quoting was a rapid process, efficient installation by respectful tradesman, polite and informative of any changes along the way. Highly recommend

When I spoke to a number of companies to get quotes I gave them all the same requirements that related to our particular  needs. Not all these companies were those suggested by SolarQuotes I might add. Two companies actually responded with system designs (and quotes of course) that actually met the design brief. Josh from Green Edge Technologies then worked with me to ensure I had all the information I needed to finalise the design. On the allotted day Benn and his team arrived and were soon into it. They were great at working with us to ensure the minimum disruption to the house. We are now enjoying the delights of our solar panels and battery system. Thanks to Benn, Josh and the team.
The process was fairly smooth and they stocked the items I was after. The installation team were A+ and well organised.

Very quick efficient and accurate quoting process.The install work started on time and was completed as planned, the install team were extremely polite and courteous as well as taking the time explaining their work and ensured you understood all the details.The inspection followed after a couple of days and was all passed without a hitch.

Sales process was great, they came out to my house and explained everything. On install day the team explained what they needed to do and kept me informed at each step. It turned out to be a difficult job considering my house layout but they were dedicated to doing a really tidy job, everything lined up nicely, very professional service. After the install there were a few minor things that needed addressing and they got them done without additional charge.Would definitely recommend to other for a professional, neat job.

After being referred to two companies via solarquotes, one company called, didn't leave message and then gave up.  Green Edge Technologies though caught me while at the dentist and were happy and patient enough to arrange a new contact time to talk through my solar install needs.  After going through requirements, they were then able to very promptly provide what I thought was an extremely reasonable quote and timeline for install of high quality products.  I was so impressed by the initial contact I was happy enough to agree there and then to lock the install in, pay the deposit and let's do it.The team provided clear details on all the requirements for solarvic and subsidies / rebates, contracts etc, making the whole process very easy.   All was coordinated and booked in within practically no time from initial contact.  I was very impressed and quite excited that the system could be put in so quickly.Prior to install the company contacted me to note they needed to change the solar panels for the install, likely due to covid supplier constraints. Thankfully though the new panels were still of the same high tier, potentially even a little better.Clear details about the install date and process were provided in advance.  The team all showed up on time and worked hard all day keeping me advised on progress and everything that was going on.  The install all went great and the system was up and working by end of day with no troubles.  The team coordinated the inspection as well and again happily for me this was able to be completed in the same week for the solar to be fully connected and running in basically about a month from first contact.  Very impressive.I should note too, while talking to the team during the install I mentioned the next home update I was thinking of was to upgrade all my lighting to efficient LED versions.  They noted oh yeah they can do that too.  I was so pleased with the ease of the solar install process, I decided yep, let's do it again.  Another quick quote and booking process and now my house is extra bright and shiny from another quality job.  While updating the lights I asked could they hardwire in a new better smoke alarm too.  They booked that in for another day and all great again.So all combined now my house is bright, safer and extra efficient.  Thanks Green Edge Technologies for all the top work!

These guys are great!  Local company that have traditional customer service and kept me up to date through out the entire process.System has turned out great and inspection is happening in a couple of days.Highly recommended!

Great customer service, had the quote out to me in hours. Very good prices and easy to deal with, the office helped me every step of the way through the process.Guys turned up on time for the installation, very friendly and easy to deal with.Overall process very smooth.Thanks.

Put through a request for a quote and received a call from Josh Allen, from Greenedge, he was incredibly helpful and took the time to answer all my questions and even asked some questions I hadn't thought of.The process to get a quote was incredibly easy and they had a quote to me in less than 24 hours. The installation was great, the team was really friendly and the install job was incredibly neat and tidy (which I am a huge fan of) and they walked me through each step and answered any further questions I had on the day. They set everything up, walked me through connecting my phone to the inverter and showed me how it all works.All in all, a really good experience and not once did I feel left in the dark, rushed or pressured into a sale and we are really pleased with our system.Thanks a lot for all the help guys, the solar industry needs more companies like you.10/10
Sales/quoting process - very efficient and quickInstallation - Polite, quick and correctCustomer service  -FANTASTIC

Most suppliers that contacted me were too busy to put in the time required to go through the process with me.Greenedge on the other hand were excellent right from first contact, and were an absolute pleasure to work with. My house was a very difficult installation, however Greenedge were one of the few that didnâ€™t shy away from the job, or try and charge an extraordinary premium. I got the system I wanted installed at a reasonable price, by people I had confidence in.
